response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems expertise with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks direct executive leadership experience in fintech or regulated environments. His background in agentic workflows and event-driven architectures is relevant, though not at the scale or seniority required for this CTO role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators, agentic workflows at re:cinq).
Deep expertise in event-driven architectures and distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby media).
Proven track record of technical leadership in scaling engineering practices (e.g., TDD, CI/CD, observability).
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience (e.g., managing 10+ engineers or board-level communication).
Limited fintech-specific experience (e.g., credit systems, regulatory compliance, or real-time risk modeling).
Agentic AI experience appears prototypical rather than production-scale with financial consequences.
